text: The Hidalgo family, through Globalia, is Air Europa's majority shareholder: in January 2026 it held 54%, with Turkish Airlines at 26% and IAG at 20%. Turkish Airlines' minority stake, formalised in November 2025 with a EUR300 million investment, was approved by Spain's council of ministers and in June 2026 awaited approval from the European Commission.
short: Air Europa is 54% the Hidalgo family's (through Globalia), 26% Turkish Airlines, 20% IAG

source.name: El Español: Juan José Hidalgo (Globalia): “Turkish me ha dado el dinero y el poder de seguir gobernando Air Europa”
source.quote: La familia Hidalgo mantiene el control de Air Europa, con un 54% de participación, mientras que Turkish Airlines tiene el 26% e IAG el 20%.

additionalSources.name: El Conciso: Juan José Hidalgo mantendrá el control total de Air Europa pese a la entrada de Turkish Airlines como accionista
additionalSources.quote: La familia Hidalgo, a través de Globalia, continuará siendo el accionista mayoritario de la compañía mientras que IAG conservará su participación actual mediante la compra de acciones a Globalia.

additionalSources.name: ch-aviation: Spain okays Turkish Airlines stake in Air Europa
additionalSources.quote: Turkish Airlines' bid for a minority stake in Air Europa was formalised in November 2025 with a EUR300 million (USD347 million) investment. The acquisition now awaits approval from the European Commission.
